summary:
Tip: review records access and transfers during the shift (capture 2026-11-10 06:18-15:18 UTC).

Supported (kept after skeptic review):
1. Policy-violating transfer: about 23.18 MB sent from workstation to 10.20.9.62:8080 at 10:27:48-10:28:03 UTC. The destination is not on the approved list and no change record covers it. Console session workstation#54 used account rhaddad. Confidence 0.8.
2. Log-forwarding stop on records: forwarding was down about 200 s (10:30:45-10:34:05 UTC, 19 missed heartbeats) after stop commands by account adm-tkim. The restart is recorded. CHG-6914 covers maintenance but its window ended at 09:18:42, before the gap. Confidence 0.7.
3. Unlisted-source remote session: adm-tkim session records#402 opened from 10.20.1.21 (not a listed admin source) at 10:30:12-10:35:00 UTC, overlapping workstation#54. No covering change. Confidence 0.75.

Not supported as incident: data staging of /home/rhaddad/Downloads/cache-0a91.bin. The file matches the size of a patients export that was downloaded at 10:26:38, and was sent out about 70 s later. The checker did not confirm a staging step, so this was downgraded. The file mtime (2026-10-11) contradicts its arrival time, which is an unresolved metadata anomaly on a host-writable record.

Benign/neutral: older access.log lines absent locally are explained by scheduled rotation (retention), with 202 lines retained at the collector. A bulk transfer to approved stor-nas-01 (10.20.0.45) by svc-backup is a scheduled backup. Four local access.log lines are missing at the collector during the forwarding gap; this is a collection gap, not proof of removal.

Attribution: accounts used were rhaddad and adm-tkim. No human operator is established. Credentials can be shared or written down, badge records do not cover remote sessions, and flow records show bytes, not content.
open_questions: What is the destination 10.20.9.62:8080, and was any approved change covering the 23 MB transfer?
Who was operating workstation#54 and records#402? Badge and remote-session records do not establish this.
Why does the cache-0a91.bin mtime (2026-10-11) predate its arrival; was the metadata altered?
Is there a change request for the records log-forwarder stop at 10:30:45 UTC outside CHG-6914?
Shell history for workstation#54 shows no matching command; the touch-screen client may not log history.
